continuity: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s bell sends a sound wave that raises the dead; the risen corpses move with their living agility and do not fear injury or death.
Ma Sanbao is among the dead following the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord; he is no longer alive as previously recorded.
Jeok Cheongang remains internally injured, but his light-flames are still powerful enough to burn the risen corpses to ash; he and Jin Taekyung fight together against the encroaching dead.

The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord says he was born during the age of chaos, lost his father and two brothers to conscription and his mother to soldiers’ violence, and later found happiness after joining the Maoshan Sect as a disciple.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord confronts the Emperor about what Taizu did to the Maoshan Sect; the battle in the banquet hall continues.
plot: As the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord rings a bell that raises thousands of powerful, agile corpses, Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang fight to protect the survivors. Jeok’s flames can burn the risen dead to ash, but the human formation is collapsing as the Demon Lord advances toward the Emperor.

The Demon Lord recalls being born into a time of war, losing his family to conscription and violence, and finding happiness among the Maoshan Sect before it was destroyed. He asks the Emperor what his grandfather, Taizu, did to the sect.
translation_decisions: Use “undead” for Jin Taekyung’s general description and “jiangshi” for Jeok Cheongang’s Maoshan-related term; keep the terms distinct.
Render the bell’s mind-reaching effect as a sound wave that raises the dead.

active_continuity: Jeok Cheongang vowed to kill every member of Dark Heaven after Hong Dao was killed by the Blood Lord.
Jeok Cheongang still suffers unexplained cold pain after the duel.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord survived a seemingly fatal death and can no longer be described as human.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord was once a Maoshan Sect disciple; the sect was destroyed resisting the forced relocation of the capital.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s bell raises the dead as powerful, agile corpses that do not fear injury or death.
Ma Sanbao, the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s Disciple, is among the risen dead following him.
Jeok Cheongang is internally injured but his light-flames can burn the risen corpses to ash.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord has advanced toward the Emperor and demands an account of Taizu’s actions against the Maoshan Sect.
The banquet-hall battle continues as the risen dead break down the human formation.
open_questions: What caused Jeok Cheongang’s unexplained cold pain?
How did the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord survive what appeared to be his death?
Can Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung stop the risen dead and protect the survivors?
What did Taizu do to the Maoshan Sect?
What will happen to the Emperor as the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord reaches him?
temporary_decisions: Keep “undead” as Jin Taekyung’s general term distinct from “jiangshi,” Jeok Cheongang’s Maoshan-related term.

profile_creations.personality: His hatred of rulers is rooted in the loss of his family to the violence of the age of chaos and the destruction of the Maoshan Sect, where he had found happiness.
profile_creations.relationships: Ma Sanbao is his Disciple; he holds the Emperor responsible for Taizu’s actions against the Maoshan Sect.
profile_creations.role: The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord is a being no longer human, a former Maoshan Sect disciple who commands the dead with a bell.
profile_creations.voice: He speaks in measured, almost lyrical phrasing, recounting the past before turning to pointed accusations.
